wholeTitleDescriptionExact.descriptionEn: The learner can access eight bounded material assessments on circular-flow data, scientific perspectives, original inquiry, commercial cases, insolvency, product development, political decision conditions and corporate participation. Navigation itself requires no prior knowledge.

findings: Both language versions describe access to eight bounded material assessments and explicitly require no prior knowledge of the navigation itself. The wording adds no assessable ordinary content or mastery claim.

The current eight child titles/descriptions cover income/elasticities, science perspectives, original inquiry, commercial cases, two bounded insolvency dossiers, theory/product/political conditions, and corporate participation. The listed topics need not pair one-to-one with each child; all real supplied subject matter is covered honestly.
requires[] preserves access and avoids inheriting all twenty-five ordinary competencies onto every independent endpoint. Each material keeps its own actual prerequisites.
contains is exactly the author supplied eight unique terminal assessment IDs. Each is atomic with no further contains; weight8 counts unique practice endpoints, not twenty-five curricular atoms.
GLOBAL and AB1 are compatibility/navigation metadata. The authoritative native kind is practiceAssessment with a structural navigation role, not a graded new AB1 skill.

No automatic course target, Source25 source coverage, runtime registration or view acceptance follows from this bounded navigation KEEP. Other four whole material science judgments belong to Root separately.
